text.content:
Naturalists have dedicated themselves to understanding one creature Species, developing an uncanny ability to track it down and survive the encounter.

SKILLS

Avid Seeker · SL max 4

Choose a Species as your Forte when you take this Skill — never humanoid. Once per scene, create a Bond of admiration or inferiority toward a creature of your Forte Species whose presence or signs you are aware of: that creature becomes your Quarry until the Bond breaks or you choose anew. You gain +(SL) to Checks to track, locate, identify and Study your Quarry. If your Quarry is absent, you may use an action and spend 1 Fabula Point to learn its direction and perform a free remote Study of it. If no Bond can form, the Species is not present and did not pass through.

Field Kit · SL max 5

On first taking this Skill choose one track — Slaying, Research, or Taming — gaining its basic tier. Each additional level buys another track's basic tier or upgrades one you hold to advanced, then superior.

  • Slaying: hit-laced infusions for 2 Inventory Points, adding +5 damage (+10 against your

Forte) with riders. Superior tier: Engineered infusions inflict through status immunity (no Pressure interaction); Adaptive infusions allowed.

  • Research: Forte consumables cost less; unlocks the spectrographic camera and the

travelling laboratory.

  • Taming: spoken commands over soldier-rank Forte creatures; then Capture — Companions

held on Loyalty Points, maximum three — then the Menagerie.

Hardened Hunter · SL max 3

While no equipment fixes your Magic Defense to a flat value, you gain +(SL) Magic Defense — +(SL + 1) against creatures of your Forte.

Prepared Ground

The four Hunter Rituals only, in a discipline flavour of your choice: Arm Up (a community gains +5 damage against your Forte via a swapped weapon Quality); Freedom (release a controlled or possessed creature — fails if it takes damage during the performance); Smoke Out (Forte creatures in the area must reveal themselves; a Villain may spend an Ultima Point to stay hidden); Land Survey (know the ritual area like the back of your hand). Helpers' Inventory Points cut the Mind Point cost, 10 MP per point.

Target Insight · SL max 2

Identify your Forte's Species on sight, and see when any visible creature is possessed or controlled. The first time each scene you Study a Forte creature (not via Avid Seeker), ask up to (SL) questions about its condition, motives or emotions.
